newsitem.title: USA: Manatee County, Fla., to guarantee seaport bonds.
newsitem.headline: Manatee County, Fla., to guarantee seaport bonds.

text.p: Florida's Manatee County has agreed to guarantee a $15 million bond issue for expansion at Port Manatee, Bradenton Herald said Wednesday.
Manatee Port Authority will receive a $15 million grant from the proceeds of a revenue bond issue by the Florida Ports Financing Commission. That bond is to be repaid with legislative appropriations.
But in order to receive the grant, the port must provide matching funds. It plans to do so by issuing $15 million of revenue bonds later this year.
At a meeting Tuesday, the county agreed to guarantee the bonds so the port can obtain a better interest rate.

"The bond rate will be substantially lower with the county guaranteeing it. With a $6 million budget obviously (the port) is not as strong as Manatee County government with a $244 million budget," said County Commissioner Lari Ann Harris, who chairs the port authority.
County revenues would only be used if port revenues are inadequate to pay debt service on the bonds. Harris said the risk of that was "less than minimal."
